script.name: prologue
script.objective: Check that the tools the group needs are on the agent and name the missing ones. Installs nothing: scripts/midair-setup.sh does that.

script.name: ts_diag
script.objective: [H5] Eight plain commands, no helper, no skip: a verdict per command with exit code and first 400 bytes of its log. Passes whenever it runs; verdicts present means H5 is false.

script.name: ts_control_known_bad
script.objective: [H2 H3 H4] Run sh -c 'echo bad >&2; exit 3' through the shell helper; PASS only when the verdict text carries exit code 3 and the text bad; FAIL when it is empty (the log capture does not work), has another exit code or lacks the text.

script.name: ts_build
script.objective: [H1 H4] PASS only when ./build.sh exits 0 and ts/dist with compiled .js files exists; the pass is a RING verdict and the test ends passed (H4). FAIL on a non-zero exit (last 400 bytes in the verdict) or a missing output.

script.name: ts_run_guess
script.objective: [H1 H2] Each reference (C++, Rust, Python, Go, C#) is started alone with 42 3; stdout, stderr, the exit code and the signal are saved, and the last 40 stderr lines and the last stage line are logged on a failure. H1 passes only when every reference exits 0 and prints 4 stage lines; a crash is named with the language, the signal and the last stage reached, and libSystem, dlopen or wrong ELF class in the output is named too. For each reference that passed H1 the stage lines and the final value are compared with the TypeScript demo and the H2 verdict names the first stage that differs. ./scripts/run.sh guess with no arguments is run and its stage count and final value are logged against the demo defaults, to explain the 7 stages and 17.6799. Controls: planted crash, planted exit and planted library error.

script.name: ts_ref_each_alone
script.objective: [H1] Each reference (C++, Rust, Python, Go, C#) in a separate process with a 20 s limit and the input 42 3; the C++ demo twice (linked with libcppcore, and from a clean build in /tmp). Logs file(1) of every .so and the CPU of the agent and fails on a CPU or library mismatch. A crash is named with the language, the signal and the last stage reached. PASS only when every run exits 0 with 4 stage lines.

script.name: ts_bad_input
script.objective: [H3] Demo (node dist/demo.js) and the HTTP entry point started directly (no listener started or awaited) with RING_HOST unset, RING_PORT unset and both bad: exit code 1, one error line, no trace, under 2 s each. The README names RING_HOST and RING_PORT as required and does not contain 127.0.0.1:9100 (planted-README controls). The verdict says code 1 and the README matches. Strict scan of ts/src and web/service-ts/src for literal IPv4 addresses, localhost and http(s):// (comment-only lines excluded and each listed), every hit printed as file:line or "scan: 0 hits", with a planted-literal control. With RING_HOST and RING_PORT unset, one unset, or RING_PORT non-numeric or out of range, the HTTP variant, run.sh guess serve and service-ts exit with code 1 within 2 s with one line, no trace, naming the variable; bad demo arguments exit non-zero in 10 s with one line and no trace.

script.name: ts_slow_peer
script.objective: [H2] service-ts on its own free port from the OS (RING_HOST, RING_PORT) with a peer on another port from the OS as upstream (SERVICE_TS_UPSTREAM): (a) accepts and never replies, (b) refuses, (c) replies after 20 s. The status and body of each answer are checked within 15 s: pass when the status is not 200, or the body has an explicit error field and no numeric fallback presented as a result (a 200 with a fallback flag only if the README states that design); the error names a timeout ((a), (c)) or a refused connection ((b)); the peer log must show an accepted connection before the answer, else the reply was input rejection and the case fails; FAIL on a trace or a leftover process. The Go timeout gap (main.go:54) is an information line.

script.name: ts_contract
script.objective: [H2] TypeScript service against its own documented contract for four inputs: 200 and a finite value (and the README formula if there is one) for a valid one, 400 with an error: line for empty, non-numeric and oversized input. The Go value is logged as information only.

script.name: ts_robust
script.objective: [H3] After ts_build passed (else blocked by H1): the process start, first output and exit times and what the test waits for are logged, so the 15 s is placed in the test or the service; node dist/main.js with EXAMPLE_PORT=9101 EXAMPLE_HOST=127.0.0.1 listens on 127.0.0.1:9101 and not 0.0.0.0 (tapi_netexpose); with both unset on 127.0.0.1:9100; empty, non-numeric, 100000-character and hostile input get 4xx replies and the process lives; SIGTERM and SIGINT give exit code 0.

script.name: ts_h1_listing
script.objective: [H1] List the project with ls and find, a verdict per command; PASS only when ts/package.json, ts/tsconfig.json and a .ts file exist, with the verdict 'H1 TypeScript example found'; else 'H1 no TypeScript example found' and FAIL.

script.name: ts_h2_build_guess
script.objective: [H2] scripts/run.sh guess for 30 s must not fail early and must print a final ring value; every reference runs alone with 42 3; the final ring value of the first one that exited 0 with 4 stages must equal 38.9640 within 1e-4, and the TypeScript value must equal it. When no reference finished the verdict says H1 failed and nothing is compared (planted-output control).

script.name: ts_h4_port_badinput
script.objective: [H3] After ts_build passed (else blocked by H1): start, first output and exit times logged; the configured and default listen address and port checked with tapi_netexpose, error replies to empty, non-numeric and 100000-character input with a live process after each, exit code 0 on SIGTERM and on SIGINT.

script.name: ts_build_run
script.objective: [H1] ./build.sh then ./scripts/run.sh guess as tapi_job programs, exit code 0 each; stdout of the run recorded as an artifact; non-zero exit fails; missing node skips.

script.name: ts_service_contract
script.objective: [H2] web/service-ts as a job: 200 and the stage body for value=42, 400 with an error line for a bad value and for a malformed target, process alive, loopback listener only.

script.name: ts_vs_go_parity
script.objective: [H3] Same six requests to service-go and service-ts, status and body compared byte for byte, both replies recorded; a difference fails and names the request.

script.name: ts_guess_default
script.objective: [H1] `./scripts/run.sh guess` gives 7 stages ending at 17.6799 and `guess 42 3` gives 4 stages ending at 38.9640, both as jobs.

script.name: ts_guess_bad_input
script.objective: [H2] RING_HOST or RING_PORT unset, `guess 1 65` and `guess abc 3` exit 1 with the documented error line; a good run is the control.

script.name: ts_serve_http
script.objective: [H3] `guess serve` as a job answers 200 to a valid GET /ring and 400 with an error: body to hops=65.

script.name: service_ts_upstream_errors
script.objective: [H4] service-ts answers 502 with a JSON error field for a closed upstream and 504 after about 5 s for a silent one; the 504 case is skipped without python3.
